verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents recurring tasks that its AI agent runs automatically on a schedule, such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps. Broadcasts can also be queued to send at a specified time. The MCP server can create and manage automations, and automations can chain delays with Wait Until blocks. Missing for 10: detailed docs on recurring-schedule configuration (cadence options, cron-like control); explicit evidence that the automations themselves, not just agent tasks, can run on a recurring schedule; evidence that schedules can be set through the MCP server or CLI; independent or hands-on corroboration.
